about_the_game:
CIVILIZATIONS: KNOWLEDGE & CONQUEST

From humble beginnings to a world-spanning empire, guide your civilization through the ages in this strategic idle game that combines resource management, knowledge advancement, and military conquest.

EXPAND YOUR KNOWLEDGE

Develop dozens of knowledge types to unlock new capabilities and technologies. Each knowledge type influences different aspects of your civilization, from agriculture and science to military tactics and culture. Watch your civilization evolve as you delve deeper into each knowledge path, with every level bringing new rewards and possibilities.

CONSTRUCT LEGENDARY WONDERS

Build magnificent wonders of the world that provide permanent bonuses to your civilization. From the Great Library to the Colosseum, each wonder requires careful resource planning but rewards you with powerful, civilization-wide benefits that last forever.

COMMAND POWERFUL ARMIES

Train and deploy armies to conquer neighboring territories. Each battle presents different challenges and rewards, with your success dependent on your military strength, technological advancement, and strategic upgrades. Victory brings honor points to enhance your military capabilities and valuable knowledge for your civilization.

ATTRACT GREAT HISTORICAL FIGURES

Discover and recruit legendary historical personalities who provide unique bonuses to your civilization. From brilliant scientists to fearsome conquerors, these Great Persons offer special abilities that can dramatically accelerate your progress and provide distinctive advantages.

BUILD A LASTING HERITAGE

The innovative Heritage system allows your achievements to persist across playthroughs. Reset your civilization to earn Heritage Points, which unlock permanent upgrades that make each new civilization stronger than the last. Build a lasting legacy that spans multiple generations of your empire!

STRATEGIC IDLE GAMEPLAY

Perfect for both active and passive play styles. Make key decisions and optimize your civilization's development, then let your empire grow while you're away with the offline progress system. Return to collect your rewards and plan your next strategic moves.

FEATURES

  • Deep progression system with multiple interconnected resources

  • Strategic decisions that impact your civilization's development path

  • Dozens of unlockable producers, upgrades, wonders, and great persons

  • Military conquest system with upgradeable capabilities

  • Heritage system for persistent progress across playthroughs

  • Offline progress so your civilization continues to thrive even when you're away

  • Beautiful, minimalist interface that puts your strategic choices front and center

Start small, think big, and forge a civilization that will stand the test of time!
